options.content: Choose a URL. OpenSearch stores every test as a document with text fields, so for that URL this dashboard can do what Graphite cannot: **list the tests with a link to each HTML result**, **group the results by any field when you query**, for example by browser, **keep every run** and not only the median, and **show which metrics changed** in a comparison. Use *Filters* to filter on any field, for example `slug` or `group`. To compare pages, use the Leaderboard.

spec.title: Latest tests
spec.description: One row for each test of the URL, newest first. Click the URL to open the HTML result of that test (needs --resultBaseURL). Graphite only stores numbers, so it cannot keep the test name or the link.

spec.query: type:pageSummary AND url:"$url" AND browser:$browser AND connectivity:$connectivity AND deviceType:$deviceType

spec.title: LCP per browser
spec.description: The LCP median over time, one line for each browser. Change the field to group by connectivity, device or test name: OpenSearch decides the grouping when you query.

spec.query: type:pageSummary AND url:"$url" AND connectivity:$connectivity AND deviceType:$deviceType

spec.title: LCP of every run
spec.description: How the LCP of every single run is spread, for the URL. A wide spread means unstable runs. Graphite only gets the median and percentiles of each test, so this needs --opensearch.includeRuns.

spec.query: url:"$url" AND browser:$browser AND connectivity:$connectivity AND deviceType:$deviceType

spec.title: LCP percentiles over all runs
spec.description: The 50th, 75th and 95th percentile of LCP over every run in each time bucket, for the URL. These are real percentiles over the runs, not an average of medians. Needs --opensearch.includeRuns.

spec.query: url:"$url" AND browser:$browser AND connectivity:$connectivity AND deviceType:$deviceType

spec.title: Tests with a significant change
spec.description: Every comparison where at least one metric changed significantly, and which metrics changed. Graphite can store the numbers but not the list of changed metrics or a link to the result.

spec.query: type:compare AND anySignificant:true AND url:"$url" AND browser:$browser AND connectivity:$connectivity AND deviceType:$deviceType
